description: Merge four duplicate service requests regarding an email server outage. Navigate to the Requests tab, identify the four tickets about the email/Outlook/Exchange outage submitted by Sarah Johnson, Mike Chen, Lisa Rodriguez, and David Thompson. Merge them into a single request, selecting Sarah Johnson's ticket ('Email server completely down...') as the Parent Request.
